enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Sleep. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Wake briefly. Turn over. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Take bread from refrigerator. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Pour boiling water into cup. Add tea bag. Remove tea bag. Take toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Eat breakfast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and setting up the home workspace for the day, no commute because of the transport strike
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Take out socks. Put on socks. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Turn on desk lamp. Adjust chair. Open email program. Check calendar. Arrange notebooks. Plug in phone charger.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely at the desk on the computer: answering emails, drafting community program plans and coordinating partner organisations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email. Read email. Type reply. Send email. Open document. Draft program plan. Save document. Open spreadsheet. Update budget. Save spreadsheet. Open video call. Join meeting. Mute microphone. Unmute microphone. Share screen. End call. Send message to partner. Check schedule.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member2. Open refrigerator. Take out lettuce. Take out tomatoes. Take out bread. Wash lettuce. Chop tomatoes. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off cooker. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Talk with Member2. Clear plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break, resting on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Lean back. Close eyes. Breathe. Open eyes. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing remote work: video calls with volunteers, updating program budgets and schedules on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open video call application. Join meeting. Greet volunteers. Discuss program. Take notes. Share screen. End call. Open budget spreadsheet. Update figures. Save. Open schedule. Adjust dates. Save. Send email to volunteers. Check messages.

enriched_activities.activity: Short tea break with Member2, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member2. Fill kettle. Turn on kettle. Take cups. Place tea bags. Wait. Pour water. Add milk. Stir. Drink tea. Talk with Member2.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing remote work: video calls with volunteers, updating program budgets and schedules on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email. Read email. Reply to email. Open document. Edit program plan. Save. Open video call. Join meeting. Discuss budget. Take notes. End call. Update schedule. Save. Send message.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa before dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Browse. Put down phone. Lean back. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with Member2 on the induction cooker and eating together
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member2. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pot. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Add spices. Stir. Turn off cooker. Plate food. Set table. Sit. Eat dinner. Talk with Member2. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with Member2 to relax
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Use remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Talk with Member2. Laugh. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Lean back. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and unwinding after the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Talk with Member2. Check phone. Browse. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Stretch. Yawn. Watch TV. Check time. Stand up.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off water. Dry with towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing on the phone under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Scroll. Like post. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Close book. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for bed and sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Wash face. Walk to bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Lie in bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
